envelope.description: VS Code Daemon tab lists repositories with completeness

body.title: VS Code Daemon tab lists repositories with completeness
body.summary: RepoRef (vscode-plugin/src/panels/types.ts:84-87) gains completeness; registeredRepos (daemon-gateway.ts:73-78) carries it from repo.list; the Daemon tab renderer (detail-renderers.ts) lists each repository with status and completeness, dispatched by webview-host.ts as today. Anchors: RepoRef at vscode-plugin/src/panels/types.ts:84-87, registeredRepos at daemon-gateway.ts:73-78, the Daemon tab renderer in detail-renderers.ts (doc comment 'The Daemon tab (ac1)' at :18-20), dispatched by webview-host.ts (:202). Depends on t12 for the field in repo.list.
acceptanceChecks: detail-renderers and daemon-gateway tests cover a complete, an incomplete and a field-less repository
A headless-Chrome screenshot of the rendered Daemon tab is read and shows the list as designed

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/panels/__tests__/daemon-gateway.test.ts and detail-renderers.test.ts: RepoRef completeness and the Daemon tab list
headless-Chrome screenshot of the rendered Daemon tab, read by eye
